entities.description: A loner who didn't want friends but didn't mind having someone to watch her back.

entities.name: Baron Bertram Graywater
entities.description: A baron who decries varmints befouling the streets of Prosperity.

entities.name: Prosperity
entities.description: A place with streets described as shining.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: A group whose inscription speaks of devouring the hope of a world.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: The vault's ultimate prize, which wasn't what Kellan had imagined.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: One who sought the vault's ultimate prize.

entities.name: Angeline
entities.description: A character who revealed a side of herself no one had seen before.

events.summary: Kellan discovers that the vault's ultimate prize, Loot, is not what he imagined.
events.quote: The vault's ultimate prize wasn't exactly what Kellan had imagined.

events.summary: Angeline reveals a side of herself no one had seen before.
events.quote: No one had seen this side of Angeline before, not even her.

relations.note: Kellan sought the vault's prize, which turned out to be Loot.
